query:
SELECT jsonb_build_object('depth',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(x)),'[]') FROM (SELECT kind,count(*) FROM jobs WHERE finished_at IS NULL GROUP BY kind) x),'jobs',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(x)),'[]') FROM (SELECT id,kind,attempts,max_attempts,locked_at,locked_by,finished_at,error,run_after FROM jobs WHERE CASE $1::text
            WHEN 'running' THEN finished_at IS NULL AND locked_at IS NOT NULL
            WHEN 'failed' THEN finished_at IS NOT NULL AND error IS NOT NULL
            WHEN 'complete' THEN finished_at IS NOT NULL AND error IS NULL
            WHEN 'pending' THEN finished_at IS NULL AND locked_at IS NULL
            ELSE true END ORDER BY created_at DESC,id DESC LIMIT 100 OFFSET $2) x)) AS "page!"
